about.title: Who is Marco?
about.p1: Welcome! This site tracks my long-distance cycling journey across Europe and beyond in real time.
about.p2: You can follow the GPS track, check daily travel statistics, and discover photos taken along the route directly from the main map.
about.p3: The source code of this project is available on GitHub, together with the scripts that prepare the data and the workflow used to update the map automatically.
